definitions.explanation: Indicates something will happen in a short time.

examples.japanese: {電車|でんしゃ}が{間|ま}もなく{到着|とうちゃく}します。
{間|ま}もなく{始|はじ}まります。
{間|ま}もなく{春|はる}が{来|く}る。

notes:
{間|ま}もなく means "soon" or "shortly"—more formal than もうすぐ.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {間|ま}もなく: soon, shortly (formal)
- もうすぐ: soon (casual)
- すぐ: immediately, right away
- そのうち: before long, sometime (vague)

COMMON CONTEXTS:
Often heard in public announcements:
- {間|ま}もなく{電車|でんしゃ}が{参|まい}ります (The train will arrive shortly)
- {間|ま}もなく{開演|かいえん}です (The show will begin shortly)

ETYMOLOGY:
Literally "without interval" ({間|ま} = interval + もなく = without).
